top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a mature, fundamental macro-finance advance: collateral values, balance sheets, and credit conditions became durable mechanisms for amplifying aggregate shocks. Kiyotaki and Moore anchor the collateral-feedback mechanism and Gertler the complementary financial-accelerator strand; a narrow citation can recognize their shared advance without treating it as one jointly originated model or claiming exhaustive credit for macro-finance.
